selection: Eight independent UK acceptance images (seven positive and one hard negative), forty analyst visible-object boxes and seven asset groups were frozen before any model inference.
evaluation: Compare fixed full-frame, tiled and proposal-fusion techniques at both predeclared score and IoU points. Preserve raw per-region outputs and unmatched predictions.
claim_boundary: This is a prospective, analyst-reference localisation technique diagnostic. References are not expert-reviewed inspection truth; MPID classes are collapsed to generic insulator proposals and are not UK material claims. Scores are uncalibrated and not probabilities.
budget: One inference-only Roihu gputest job, at most ten minutes, with no threshold tuning, retraining or retry selected from acceptance results.
